title: Quot-Stack Moduli and Transverse Deformations of Graded Metabelian Lie Algebras
summary: We identify the graded metabelian locus inside the deformation theory of positively graded Lie algebras. Let $M(U)$ be the free metabelian Lie algebra on $U$ and $B(U)=M(U)'$. For every finite graded rank vector $h$, we prove that the moduli stack of such algebras is equivalent to the quotient stack $[\mathrm{Quot}^{\mathrm{gr}}h(B(U))/\mathrm{GL}(U)]$. At a quotient $B(U)\to C$ with kernel $N$, its tangent complex is the two-term complex from $\mathrm{End}(U)$ to $\mathrm{Hom}{\mathrm{Sym}(U)}(N,C)_0$.
